LivingTogether.title: LivingTogether
LivingTogether.description: Arrangement whereby two people who are not married live together.

Birth.description: The coming into the world of a Person.

ReferenceAddress.title: ReferenceAddress
ReferenceAddress.description: Address of another person or legal entity for persons without a fixed residence.

AddressPresentation.administrativeUnitLe.title: AddressPresentation.administrativeUnitLevel1

AddressPresentation.administrativeUnitLe.title: AddressPresentation.administrativeUnitLevel2
AddressPresentation.administrativeUnitLe.description: The region of the address, usually a province or state or similar area that typically includes several places.

AddressPresentation.addressArea.title: AddressPresentation.addressArea
AddressPresentation.addressArea.description: Name of a geographical area or place that groups a number of addressable objects to address them without the area or place being an administrative unit. For example, the name of the hamlet in which the address is located.

AddressPresentation.boxNumber.title: AddressPresentation.boxNumber
AddressPresentation.boxNumber.description: Officially assigned alphanumeric code that is added to the house number to distinguish several building units, pitches, berths or plots that have the same house number. Specialization of Address Presentation: location indication for Belgian addresses.

AddressPresentation.houseNumber.title: AddressPresentation.houseNumber
AddressPresentation.houseNumber.description: Alphanumeric code officially assigned to building units, berths, stands or plots. Specialization of Address Presentation: location indication for Belgian addresses.

AddressPresentation.country.title: AddressPresentation.country
AddressPresentation.country.description: Country in which the address is located.

AddressPresentation.locationIndicator.title: AddressPresentation.locationIndicator

AddressPresentation.locationName.title: AddressPresentation.locationName
AddressPresentation.locationName.description: Name or description of the geographical object that the address locator denotes.

AddressPresentation.p.O.Box.title: AddressPresentation.p.O.Box
AddressPresentation.p.O.Box.description: PO Box number in a post office.

AddressPresentation.postalCode.title: AddressPresentation.postalCode
AddressPresentation.postalCode.description: Code that identifies the geographical area that groups addresses for postal purposes.

AddressPresentation.postName.title: AddressPresentation.postName

AddressPresentation.completeAddress.title: AddressPresentation.completeAddress
AddressPresentation.completeAddress.description: The complete address in one string, formatted or not. Avoids errors due to splitting an address into its parts. Displays the prescribed order of the different parts.
